verdict.rationale: Lambda has a public pricing page that promises "clear, straightforward pricing" for Instances, 1-Click Clusters and Superclusters, with self-serve B200, H100, A100 and GH200 instances billed by the hour in one-minute increments. A community post confirms a published H100 on-demand rate of $1.99/GPU/hour. However, the evidence never shows the actual per-GPU-hour figures for each GPU type, and the lowest reserved-capacity prices require contacting sales. Missing for 10: evidence of listed per-GPU-hour prices for every GPU type (B200, GH200, A100, etc.) on the pricing page, published reserved and cluster pricing without a sales contact, and current independent corroboration of the listed rates.
